status_note: Proposed by WO-001 on 2026-10-31. Frozen only after the owner has not objected and before WO-002 runs them (AGENTS.md section 5.2). Every number is estimated; none is measured.

justification.max_setpoint_age_ns: A 20 Hz command stream may miss three setpoints. At the 1.0 m/s garage limit this is 0.2 m of travel (0.1 m at the 0.5 m/s room limit), counted in the reaction term in docs/OPERATING_ENVELOPE.md.
justification.max_sensor_age_ns: Over four frames at 30 Hz, the minimum rate Isaac ROS Visual SLAM states. Counted in the same reaction term.
justification.max_estimator_age_ns: PX4 recommends external vision at 30 to 50 Hz [D43]; 100 ms allows about two missed updates at 30 Hz or four at 50 Hz. To be replaced with measurements.

sim_limits.note: The highest indoor limit in docs/OPERATING_ENVELOPE.md, used so the arithmetic's worst case is exercised. Enforced by the command gate on setpoints and by MPC_XY_VEL_MAX. D1 confirms Position mode obeys it.

ET-D1-1.threshold: 2/2 clean launches report identical versions; zero null pins

ET-D1-2.threshold: 10/10 nominal runs reach every waypoint within 0.5 m, checked by independent code from logged state

ET-D1-4.threshold: every listed fault case executed and logged; any deviation from specification reported; configured and tested behaviour recorded separately

ET-D1-5.threshold: freshness gate tests green with the bounds above; heartbeat continuity never counts as setpoint freshness

failsafe_cases_added_by_wo001: no manual control at arming: offboard loss
simulated manual control present at arming, then removed: NAV_RCL_ACT, kill switch, stick override, mode switch
GPS disabled, vision position only, with and without a global origin: record the mode entered on offboard loss
companion computer death: setpoint stream stops
